findings.issue: The required neutral activity-and-location fallback is absent after permit boilerplate removal. For a permit whose reported action is only removable boilerplate, such as 'CBC 2019.', permitWorkTitle returns 'Construction activity' without its location. When supported_action is absent but a raw permit evidence abstract is present, reportedAction passes that whole structured abstract to the title parser, which can expose a 'row: <permit ID>' heading instead of the described work. These are ordinary missing/low-information evidence states and breach the packet's safe heading fallback.
findings.required_repair: Keep the existing grouping and current 50-row results. Derive a title only from a usable work description; otherwise return a neutral activity plus the record location. Add focused cases for a boilerplate-only action and a raw permit abstract with no supported_action.

accepted_evidence: The nineteen exact Zilker rows safely produce one presentation card, each source permit remains available, all 50 records remain counted, non-identical phase/date/activity rows stay separate, and controller runtime proof reports 32 cards with no browser errors or mobile overflow.
